mapper.select: SELECT ranking, isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, image_url, start_dt, end_dt, fetched_at FROM popular_book WHERE start_dt = #{startDt} AND end_dt = #{endDt} AND ranking BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{size} ORDER BY ranking
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO popular_book ( ranking, isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, image_url, start_dt, end_dt ) VALUES
( #{i.ranking}, #{i.isbn13}, #{i.title}, #{i.authors}, #{i.publisher}, #{i.publicationYear}, #{i.imageUrl}, #{i.startDt}, #{i.endDt} )
ON CONFLICT (isbn13, start_dt, end_dt) DO UPDATE SET ranking = EXCLUDED.ranking, title = EXCLUDED.title, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, publisher = EXCLUDED.publisher, publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, fetched_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM popular_book WHERE end_dt < now() - INTERVAL '3 days'
mapper.select: SELECT isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, class_no, class_name, description, image_url, fetched_at FROM book WHERE isbn13 = #{isbn13}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( isbn13, title, authors, publisher, publication_year, class_no, class_name, description, image_url ) VALUES ( #{isbn13}, #{title}, #{authors}, #{publisher}, #{publicationYear}, #{classNo}, #{className}, #{description}, #{imageUrl} ) ON CONFLICT (isbn13) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, publisher = EXCLUDED.publisher, publication_year = EXCLUDED.publication_year, class_no = EXCLUDED.class_no, class_name = EXCLUDED.class_name, description = EXCLUDED.description, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, fetched_at = now()
